request: make the header/footer look like this template
summary: Give every section the template's headers and footers: the cover section gets the template's cover header/footer, every body section the template's body header/footer. Placeholders are filled from each spec's own content — the section number from its current footer, the section title from the paragraph after 'SECTION nn nn nn' — and the issue stamp with the approved wording. Tab stops are rescaled to each section's text width and the template's look is pinned; the old headers/footers are removed; body text is untouched.
assumptions: template slots are the yellow-highlighted placeholders and the {{NAME}} placeholders (decision §14.2)
the section number is the 'nn nn nn' at the start of the document's current footer
the section title is the first non-empty paragraph after the 'SECTION nn nn nn' paragraph
header/footer distances and titlePg follow the template; page margins stay as they are
pending tracked changes inside the old headers/footers are discarded with them and flagged by name

expect.members_added: the template's header/footer parts (+ rels, logo)
